manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball rises and falls beside a fixed height scale with a launch guide. The blue Motion arrow shortens, is absent at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const v=u-g*t,h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const at=u/g;const top=Math.abs(t-at)<0.005;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const base=370,sc=60;const bx=300,by=base-h*sc-14;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:370,title:'Tossed ball',state:'Height scale fixed'}));o.push(sdk.axis('axis.h',{x:90,y:base,length:300,orientation:'y',min:0,max:5,ticks:[0,1,2,3,4,5],label:'Height',unit:'m'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide.launch',90,base,520,base,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',bx,by,28,{role:'output'}));if(!top)o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:bx+40,y:by},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:12,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:bx+90,y:by},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:4,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(420,by-30,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:u/g,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
